description: This is a Java test class for the PredefinedShelfRepository in a Spring Data JPA context. It contains unit tests for repository methods related to PredefinedShelf entities, such as finding shelves by name and user, retrieving all shelves for a user, and counting shelves. The class is part of the testing suite for the book project.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepositoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing PredefinedShelfRepository methods, including finding by name, listing all shelves for a user, and counting shelves.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test data by creating shelves for test users before each test.

methods.name: findCorrectShelf
methods.description: Tests that a predefined shelf can be correctly retrieved by name and user.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUserReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that querying for a non-existent shelf returns empty.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Verifies that all shelves for a specific user are retrieved correctly.

methods.name: findAllByUserIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that when shelves are deleted, no shelves are returned for the user.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Checks that the count of shelves for a user matches the expected number.

methods.name: createShelvesForUser
methods.description: Creates predefined shelves for a given user for testing purposes.
